rules.statement: A treatment or harvest counts towards a quarterly report only if its date falls within the quarter: on or after the first day of the quarter and before the first day of the next quarter (start included, end excluded).
rules.subject: treatment start date / harvest date

rules.statement: In the quarterly report, a hive is counted as flagged for varroa based on its status at the end of the quarter.
rules.subject: varroa flag evaluation date
